findings.detail: Hardcoded #ffffff bypasses the existing theme.colors.textOnPrimary token. This is a pervasive PRE-EXISTING codebase pattern (color: #ffffff appears in 31 files including the sibling AdminFleetsPage/AdminLoginPage this WI mirrors); textOnPrimary is used for button text almost nowhere. Observed, not introduced by this change; classified LOW because holding WI-4 to a standard the whole codebase and its own siblings do not meet would be inconsistent. The alpha-concat and the two magic px are also consistent with existing admin/driver precedents. Recommend a separate cleanup sweep, not a WI-4 blocker.

The color-input placeholder is a literal format token (#RRGGBB example), defensibly exempt like the cs-CZ money/Kc formatting literals — it is not translatable prose. All actual user-facing strings (labels, hints, banners, validation, aria) go through t(). Could route through t() for consistency but no localization value; non-blocking.

Developer handoff honestly discloses the page suite was RED only at import-resolution, not per-assertion RED-first. The SECURITY blank->null assertion genuinely guards the blank->"" clear-key regression; behaviour coverage is complete and green. Process note, not a defect in delivered code.
